_comment: Per-implementation adapter config for the Bifrost meta test harness.
Each adapter declares how to drive one Shen port. Bifrost substitutes:
{bin}  -> the resolved launcher binary (after env-var / default resolution)
{expr} -> a Shen expression string (for eval mode)
{file} -> an absolute path to a .shen program (for script mode)
Templates are argv lists (NOT shell strings): no quoting/word-splitting games.
Path resolution order for each impl's binary:
1. the env var named in 'env'
2. the first existing path in 'default_paths'
If none resolve, the impl is SKIPPED and reported (never a hard error).
'eval'  : argv template that evaluates {expr} and prints its value to stdout.
'script': argv template that runs the .shen program at {file} to stdout.
'version': argv template that prints the kernel version banner to stdout.
If absent, Bifrost falls back to eval of (version).
'repl'  : argv template that starts the interactive REPL (fed EOF on stdin).
'hush_writes_file': KNOWN cross-impl divergence. true  = `pr` to a file
stream still writes even under -q/*hush*; false = -q silences it
(zero-byte file). Documented, NOT asserted as agreement.
Note: shen-cl REQUIRES -q for clean eval/repl output; shen-rust/shen-lua
MUST omit -q for normal cases or `pr` output is silenced.

shen-lua._version_note: shen-lua has no --version flag; Bifrost falls back to eval of (version).

shen-scheme._note: Chez Scheme port by tizoc (Bruno Deferrari). Binary finds its boot file (lib/shen-scheme/shen.boot) relative to the executable, so cwd-independent. -q maps to --quiet -> (set *hush* true), which silences stdout (so it is NOT passed for normal eval/script cases); file-stream pr still writes under -q. Converged with the 41.2 reference ports on all bifrost cases (kernel 41.2; clean stdin-EOF exit; hush gates stdout only).
